title: Blackslex and Penguin Civilization
statementMd:
*Penguins are civilized creatures that communicate using permutations. Blackslex, as a penguin researcher, must study their means of communication.*

For a given integer n, consider permutations^{\text{∗}} p of the array [0, 1, \ldots, 2^n - 1]. Define S(p) \;=\; \sum_{i=0}^{2^n-1} \operatorname{popcount}\!\bigl(p_0 \mathbin{\&} p_1 \mathbin{\&} \cdots \mathbin{\&} p_i\bigr), where \operatorname{popcount}(z) is the number of 1-bits in the binary representation of z (for instance, \operatorname{popcount}(5) = 2 because 5 = 101_2 has two 1-bits in the binary representation), and \& denotes the [bitwise AND operation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#AND). .

A permutation is considered **sacred** if it maximizes S(p). Find the **lexicographically minimal**^{\text{†}} sacred permutation.

^{\text{∗}}A permutation of length n is an array consisting of n distinct integers from 1 to n in arbitrary order. For example, [2,3,1,5,4] is a permutation, but [1,2,2] is not a permutation (2 appears twice in the array), and [1,3,4] is also not a permutation (n=3 but there is 4 in the array).

^{\text{†}}An array a is lexicographically smaller than an array b of the same size if and only if the following holds:

- in the first position where a and b differ, the array a has a smaller element than the corresponding element in b.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer t (1 \le t \le 16) — the number of test cases.

Each test case contains a single integer n (1 \le n \le 16).

It is guaranteed that the sum of 2^n over all test cases does not exceed 2^{16}.

## Output

For each test case, output 2^n integers p_0, p_1, \ldots, p_{2^n-1} — the required permutation.

## Note

For the first test case, there are two possible permutations.

- p = [0, 1], S(p) = 0
- p = [1, 0], S(p) = 1

For the second test case, S([3, 1, 0, 2]) = 3 is sacred. There are other permutations p that are sacred, such as p = [3, 2, 0, 1], but those are not lexicographically minimal.
statementZhMd:
*企鹅是使用排列进行交流的文明生物。作为一名企鹅研究员，Blackslex 必须研究它们的交流方式。*

对于给定的整数 n，考虑数组 [0, 1, \ldots, 2^n - 1] 的排列^{\text{∗}} p。定义 S(p) \;=\; \sum_{i=0}^{2^n-1} \operatorname{popcount}\!\bigl(p_0 \mathbin{\&} p_1 \mathbin{\&} \cdots \mathbin{\&} p_i\bigr)，其中 \operatorname{popcount}(z) 表示 z 的二进制表示中 1 的个数（例如，\operatorname{popcount}(5) = 2，因为 5 = 101_2 的二进制表示中有两个 1），\& 表示[按位与运算](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#AND)。

若一个排列能最大化 S(p)，则称该排列为**神圣的**。请找出**字典序最小**^{\text{†}}的神圣排列。

^{\text{∗}}长度为 n 的排列是一个由 n 个 1 到 n 之间互不相同的整数按任意顺序组成的数组。例如，[2,3,1,5,4] 是一个排列，而 [1,2,2] 不是排列（2 在数组中出现了两次），[1,3,4] 也不是排列（n=3 但数组中出现了 4）。

^{\text{†}}当且仅当满足以下条件时，数组 a 的字典序小于同等大小的数组 b：

- 在 a 与 b 第一个不同的位置上，数组 a 的元素小于数组 b 中对应位置的元素。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 t (1 \le t \le 16) — 表示测试用例的组数。

每个测试用例包含一个整数 n (1 \le n \le 16)。

保证所有测试用例的 2^n 之和不超过 2^{16}。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出 2^n 个整数 p_0, p_1, \ldots, p_{2^n-1} — 即所求的排列。

## 说明

对于第一个测试用例，有两种可能的排列。

- p = [0, 1], S(p) = 0
- p = [1, 0], S(p) = 1

对于第二个测试用例，S([3, 1, 0, 2]) = 3 是神圣的。还存在其他神圣的排列 p，例如 p = [3, 2, 0, 1]，但它们不是字典序最小的。
